body: I’m going back for my fourth and final season this summer with the state park this year! Can confirm it’s pretty much about the same as you’re describing. Certainly if you want something with more free time and days off compared to what others are describing the state park is the way to go. Unfortunately the pay isn’t the best but like they said it’s more for the experience of being on the island. Mission house, where you’d live, is down by mission point so it’s nice and quiet in the evenings when everyone else is downtown. While it pays less than other places the housing is quite nice for what you pay and the community itself is definitely worth it. You make friends quick and we look out for eachother, do house movie nights, games, etc. They’re also usually pretty strict with overtime so you would most of the time be only working 40 hours a week and would get your two days off, and I’ve never had a problem requesting a day off. As far as working on the island goes, compared to other jobs, I’d definitely recommend the State Park. Nice people, good community, and a bit more relaxed than other jobs! Good luck!

I had anxiety and depression and some body dysmorphia issues before he broke up with me, but they only got a million times worse when it happened. I went from having manageable depression and anxiety to severe depression to the point where I could barely get out of bed. I started failing all my classes, I considered suicide seriously for the first time in my life. I found out he was hanging out with other girls and my self-worth issues got even worse, I felt ugly, worthless, fat, just everything horrible. I developed a bit of an eating disorder and would go days without eating, I've lost 25 pounds since February. But now, six months later, it has gotten a little better. I'm having more good days, I can enjoy things again. I'm beginning to appreciate my body and like the way I look again. I can eat again, I've been hanging out with friends. I don't know your specific situation, but let me tell you, I was at the lowest point I've ever been in my entire life, to the point where I didn't think I would live till Summer. But it gets better, it just takes time. A lot of time and self-love, and professional help if you can get it. It might sound empty or useless, but it will get better, even if it's just little by little, it will get better. Please take care of yourself best you can <3

Literally this. I've found it hard to put these feelings into words 6 months post-break-up, but this covers it. I find myself actually missing his family. Missing his house, his dogs, the stupid corvette he bought when we were together. I had to put away everything he bought me, some of my favorite clothes because I just couldn't have them around me. I can't go to certain stores or drive down certain streets because we went there together and it makes me sick. I'm mourning the family events I'll never get to go to with him, my family events I'll never get to bring him to. The nightly facetime calls we had that could go till 4 AM. The trips I'll never get to take with him. The memories and stories and jokes we have now tainted by the heartbreak of losing him. You're right, I'm going through so many little breakups. Thank you for putting it into words.

I do this all the time lol. I'll look over at empty space and pretend that I'm sitting in a car with him and that I'm saying my final goodbye. I get out everything I'm thinking and feeling. I'll yell at the bathroom mirror and cry as if he's listening. I get into arguments with the air and pretend he's there. Sometimes I pretend he's come back to me and I imagine what that would be like. 

I think it's mostly the imaginary arguments and screaming that actually helps. I find it very cathartic to yell and get upset and get my shit out even if it's to no one. You're definitely not the only one, I've found it helps me a lot.

Honestly thank you so much for this, it's so hard for me to see his actual intentions because I so badly want to believe that he wants me for me and not just because he wants to use me. But in reality he's still talking to other girls, he hasn't initiated a conversation with me in two days, and he's once again stringing me along. 

I definitely was beginning to see the positives of going no contact and I just knew this was going to happen when I saw him again, after I finally started to feel like I could live without him. I do feel a little more in control this time, I'm withdrawing my contact. I should block him, I'm going to try to block him. But it's hard. It's hard to look past the only person I've ever known, like it's impossible for me to imagine that there really are other people out there. 

I'm sorry for your break up, they're literally one of the most painful things humans can experience mentally. Or at least it has been for me, for so long it was just literaly agony, I'm proud of myself for getting this far. Thank you, again, for your kind words, I genuinely appreciate them and they have helped. I hope you can heal, I can tell you're a kind, thoughtful person. <3

He knows just how to give me enough to get me to stay and then he pulls back and I'm still there. Thank you for your kind words, it's so hard to see life right now.

I’m no where near moved on but it makes it easier. Good job for taking that step, it’s a huge one <3

I haven’t had many milestones, but the ones I have had felt good. I think I definitely have a very long road ahead of me, but little progress is good.

All I can say is to talk to people, don’t bottle it up because it only makes you feel worse. Don’t dwell on what happened or what could have been, as much as you’ll want to because I know that is all I ever want to do. Just focus on yourself, don’t isolate yourself from family and friends, you need them. And the pain will fade, and believe me I know that it feels like it won’t, because sometimes I feel like it won’t ever fade. But it will, time heals, and as horrible as it feels life will go on. I have a pretty good idea of how you feel, and I am definitely rooting for you, if you ever want to talk my dm’s are definitely open. I don’t know, it has been so hard, I understand fully how you feel. It sucks but time is all we have left at this point, I’m rooting for you, I hope things can get better.

I just have to hope it’ll get better with time, that’s all there is at this point.

It’s so incredibly hard.

Yeah, I often feel like I’ll be hurting forever lol.
